name: Broccoli Farro Delight
notes: Eat as a main or side dish, hot or cold, topped with a fried egg or salad greens if desired.

items: Finely grated zest, then juice, of 1 lemon

steps.title: Cook the farro
steps.body: Cook **1 cup farro** in a medium pot of salted water, like you would pasta (about 25-30 minutes until al dente, but check the package as cooking times vary widely depending on the type of farro). Drain.

steps.title: Chop the broccoli
steps.body: Meanwhile, chop **1 pound broccoli** (if frozen, thaw before proceeding further) into approx. ½-inch bits.

steps.title: Cook the sausage
steps.body: Cook **½ lb Italian sausage** (optional) in a frying pan. Place on a paper towel-covered plate, but don’t clean the pan.

steps.title: Saute the garlic
steps.body: Add **2-3 Tbsp olive oil**. Saute **2 cloves garlic, minced** and red pepper flakes until the garlic is golden.

steps.title: Cook the broccoli
steps.body: Add the broccoli, lemon zest and **1 tsp salt**. Cook until the broccoli is tender.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Combine the farro, sausage, broccoli mixture, lemon juice, salt and pepper to taste, and **4 oz parmesan**.
